info.name: Google Data Studio Assets Permissions API
info.description:
The Looker Studio API (formerly Google Data Studio API) enables programmatic management of Looker Studio assets, including searching for assets and managing permissions within Google Workspace or Cloud Identity organizations. The API is only available to users that belong to an organization with Google Workspace or Cloud Identity.

Contact Support:
 Name: Google

item.name: Google Data Studio Get asset permissions

variable.description: (Required) The name (ID) of the Looker Studio asset.

request.description: Retrieves the access controls (permissions) for a specified Looker Studio asset. Returns a Permissions object containing a map of roles to their assigned members, along with an etag for concurrency control.

response.name: Successful response containing the asset's permissions.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: oauth2

response.name: Insufficient permissions to view asset access controls.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: oauth2

response.name: The specified asset was not found.

item.name: Google Data Studio Update asset permissions

variable.description: (Required) The name (ID) of the Looker Studio asset.

request.description: Modifies the access controls for a specified Looker Studio asset. Replaces the permissions with the provided values. The OWNER role cannot be updated through this endpoint. Use the etag field for optimistic concurrency control to detect and fail on concurrent modifications.

response.name: Successful response containing the updated permissions for the asset.

response.name: Invalid request. May occur if attempting to modify the OWNER role.

item.name: Google Data Studio Add members to an asset

variable.description: (Required) The name (ID) of the Looker Studio asset.

request.description: Adds members to a specified role on a Looker Studio asset. Members cannot be added to the OWNER role. Members are identified by a type prefix such as user:, group:, domain:, or serviceAccount: followed by the identifier.

response.name: Successful response containing the updated permissions for the asset.

response.name: Invalid request. May occur if attempting to add members to the OWNER role.

item.name: Google Data Studio Revoke all permissions for members

variable.description: (Required) The name (ID) of the Looker Studio asset.

request.description: Removes specified members from all roles on a Looker Studio asset. Owners cannot be removed, and the authorized user cannot remove themselves. Revoking permissions for an invalid member or a member that does not belong to the asset will not cause the request to fail. Well-formed requests always return a 200 OK response.

response.name: Successful response containing the updated permissions. Always returned for well-formed requests even if a member is invalid or does not belong to the asset.
